summary: The original SSE contract and server-ownership gap is resolved in the proposal. The endpoint and event envelope are enumerated; committed-counter observation covers separate writer processes; each connection rechecks authority and generations; bounded lifecycle/reconnect semantics are specified. PR-58 owns server publication and PR-40 consumes it with an explicit dependency. PR-54 transitively depends on PR-58 and requires the actual cross-process SSE path for SC-004. No performance measurement or implementation success is asserted.
